text: Multi-root Workspace 是一款面向 DSH Web 客户端及命令界面的 DSH 插件，可让 Agent 在主工作区之外使用多个经登记的文件夹。它替换文件系统与沙箱提供者，并通过共享注册表维护附加根目录；用户可为每个目录设置继承、只读或读写权限。插件提供 /workspace-folders 命令和侧栏文件夹管理面板，可添加、移除、命名、切换目录，查看文件树，并把附加根用于技能发现、指令读取和 LSP 工作区。适合需要跨多个仓库协作的 DSH 用户。使用前需要安装 DSH 插件，并运行受支持版本的 DSH；无需额外 API Key。

Multi-root Workspace lets DSH agents work across registered folders as well as the primary workspace. Set per-folder access, manage roots from a command or sidebar, browse files, and include extra roots in skill, instruction and LSP workflows. Requires a supported DSH release; no API key.

Can I browse and switch between additional workspace roots in the DSH sidebar?
Multi-root Workspace 的功能「登记附加根目录」：通过 /workspace-folders add 或侧栏面板选择文件夹，把额外目录加入当前工作区，并为该目录选择继承、只读或读写权限。
Multi-root Workspace 的功能「配置目录访问级别」：为每个附加根设置继承会话模式、固定只读或固定读写；访问级别参与工作区授权，而不是仅显示在界面上。
Multi-root Workspace 的功能「浏览和切换目录」：侧栏 Files 页签可选择主根或附加根，并在原生文件树中浏览当前目录内容。
Multi-root Workspace 的功能「管理文件夹」：Workspace Folders 面板可列出已登记目录，并支持添加、移除和别名管理等操作。
Multi-root Workspace 的功能「跨根路径路由」：工作区文件请求按路径所属的主根或附加根解析，且相对路径以主目录为基准。
Multi-root Workspace 的功能「刷新根目录状态」：列出目录时重新检查注册路径，并更新可用状态，使恢复的目录无需重启即可重新显示。
Multi-root Workspace 的功能「读取附加根指令」：bundle 加载 instruction 服务，为附加目录纳入额外的项目指令文件。
Multi-root Workspace 的功能「发现附加根技能」：bundle 加载技能支持，使附加项目目录中的技能可以纳入 DSH 技能流程。
@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · Introduction：
@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace：中文 | [English](./README.en.md)

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · 项目简介：[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 默认把新建工作区所在的目录作为 Agent 的主目录，在默认的工作区读写模式（`workspace-write`）下，沙箱的读写范围也仅覆盖这一个目录。本插件将 DSH 的工作区范围拓展到“一个主目录 + 多个附加目录”。

并非所有项目都是 monorepo。一个开发项目往往由多个独立 Git 仓库组成，跨仓库干活原本得反复换会话。同类工具早已支持在一个工作区添加多个文件夹，本插件把同样的能力带给 DSH：把其他仓库登记为附加根，并按需授予只读、读写或不受限的访问级别，Agent 即可在授权范围内读写。

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · 项目简介：- **不新增工具**：Agent 照旧使用原生 `read` / `write` / `edit` / `bash`，只是授权的目录变多了。
- **沙箱约束**：附加根可继承会话（主目录）的权限设置，也可单独固定为只读或读写；在只读与读写下，约束不靠系统提示词，而由进程内文件围栏 + 内核级沙箱（macOS Seatbelt / Linux bwrap / Landlock / Windows ACL）执行，经本插件围栏的原生文件与 bash 共享同一份授权范围；自行启动 Worker 的第三方工具须单独验证，dsh-ops 的现存缺口见下方已知限制。
- **Files 页签浏览附加根**：Files 页签头部可直接在主根与任一已登记附加根之间切换，附加根的目录树以与主根相同的原生 Files 视图呈现，打开文件、在外部应用打开、自动刷新等操作完全一致。
- **可选 Auto review（默认关闭）**：fork 上游实验性「自动授权审查」，向 Reviewer 补充附加目录的审查上下文——当前工作区拓扑、各根访问级别与实时指令文件；出厂关闭，需在插件管理器的行列表中显式打开 `@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace/auto-review` 行后生效，启用时接管官方同名 bundle。
- **附属根 Skills**：发现附属目录的 `.dsh/skills` 与 `.agents/skills`，附属根经 `/alias-id:skill-name` 命名空间调用原生 `skill` 工具；每根独立开关、可编辑 `aliasId`，全局设置默认开启。
- **不配等于没装**：未登记附加根时行为与未装插件逐项一致；配置错误一律明确报错，从不静默降级。

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · 快速开始：插件已发布到 [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace)。在 DSH 侧栏的**插件**页点**添加插件**、填入包名 `@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace` 即可安装；也可以用命令行两步装完：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace
dsh --profile web       # --profile 按你的启动方式选择，可选值见 DSH 文档
```

tarball、GitHub、本地源码等其他安装方式见[安装](#安装)。

启动后侧栏底部出现 **Folders**（`🗂`）动作，或直接在会话里：

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · 快速开始：```text
/workspace-folders add ~/code/another-repo [--inherit|--read-only|--read-write]
```

之后 Agent 即可在该目录读写、跑 bash——默认 `inherit`，访问级别跟随会话模式。DSH 的动态 working directory 只影响新操作的相对路径和执行目录，切换 cwd 不会新增授权，也不会改变注册表归属。

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · 环境要求：**从源码构建 / 贡献**：Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24`，pnpm `11.25.0`（建议经 corepack 启用）；开发 pin 的 DSH 为 `0.2.2-rc.1`（Node ≥24.9）。

**运行平台**：macOS（Seatbelt）、Linux（bwrap / Landlock）、Windows（root-set ACL runner）。

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · 安装：不使用命令行时，DSH 侧栏的**插件**页提供同一安装入口：点**添加插件**，填入 npm 包名（或 Git 地址、tarball、本地绝对路径）。

`dsh plugin` 支持四种安装来源。以下均以 web profile 为例；桌面端（Electron）把 `--profile web` 换成 `--profile desktop`，安装方式同源。

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · 安装：| 来源 | 命令 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| npm 注册表（推荐） | `dsh plugin --profile web add @dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace` | 预构建产物，即装即用 |
| GitHub | `dsh plugin --profile web add github:cherrchen/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace` | 安装时自动从源码构建；`allowBuilds` 需含本包，建议锁定版本 |
| tarball | `dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-electron-dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace-<version>.tgz` | 预构建离线包，适合内网/离线 |
| 从源码安装 | `dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/package/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace` | pnpm `link:` 链接本地 checkout，适合开发调试；无需 `allowBuilds` |

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · 安装：**首次安装时 `dsh plugin add` 会以 `[ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS]` 失败**：在该 profile 的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 里补上下面这行，再执行一次 `add` 即可：

```yaml
allowBuilds:
  koffi: true
```

如果重跑 `退出 0` 但插件没有进入 `dsh.profile.bundles`，做一次 `remove` + `add`。更多排查见[故障排查](./docs/troubleshooting/install-stops-at-build-approval.md)。

```

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · 从 tarball 安装：```sh

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · 从 GitHub 安装：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:cherrchen/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace
```

GitHub 来源装的是源码，`add` 时会自动构建，不需要手动编译；但 `allowBuilds` 要写两行——本包自身和 `koffi`：

```

```

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · 命令：```text
/workspace-folders [list]                                                   # 列出主根与附加根（含每根访问级别与状态）
/workspace-folders add <absolute path> [--inherit|--read-only|--read-write] # 不带路径时打开系统目录选择器；新登记默认 inherit
/add-dirs [absolute path] [--inherit|--read-only|--read-write]              # /workspace-folders add 的快捷命令
/workspace-folders access <order|path> inherit|read-only|read-write         # 切换访问级别（扩权要求该根此刻可用）

路径可带引号；与已有根重复、嵌套在已有根内部、或就是主根本身的路径会被拒绝。

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · 命令：访问级别是三态的（[ADR-0017](./docs/decisions/ADR-0017-three-state-root-access-and-sandbox-modes.md)，语义细节见[使用指南](./docs/guide/README.md#访问级别数量上限与-per-tool-封顶)）：`inherit` 跟随会话模式——`workspace-write` 可写、`read-only` 拒写、`danger-full-access` 不受限；`read-only` 在任何模式下都拒写（包括 Full-access）；`read-write` 固定在只读会话里仍可写。旧版插件登记的可写记录升级后按 `inherit` 读。每个主根最多登记 16 个附加根（`maxAdditionalRoots` 配置可调至 64）。宿主还可以在 `multi-root-scope` 行配置 `toolAccess`，例如 `{ bash: 'read-only' }` 让 bash 永远不能写任何附加根（仍可写主根）。

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · 命令：`add` 后执行 `list` 的预期输出（`workspace-write` 会话，website 登记为只读）：

```text
Workspace root (primary; access follows the current sandbox mode): /home/me/monorepo
  1 /home/me/payments-service [支付] (inherit)
  2 /home/me/website (read-only)
2 of 16 additional roots.

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · 附属根 Skills：发现附属目录的 `.dsh/skills` 和 `.agents/skills`，首个模型步骤可见名称与描述，正文按需加载。主根使用 `/skill-name`；附属根始终使用 `/alias-id:skill-name`，可在 Slash 菜单补全或手动输入。模型通过原生 `skill` 工具调用内部名称；工具日志中可能显示内部 ID，人类菜单只列命名空间引用。

新登记的 `inherit` / `read-write` 根默认开启，`read-only` 根默认关闭；Workspace Folders Dialog 可独立切换 Skills 并编辑 `aliasId`。显示 Alias 的修改不改变 `aliasId`。只有登记权限的实际变化才重置开关；切换会话沙箱模式、同值权限设置和未改变权限的重新登记都保留手动选择。只读根开启 Skills 后仍没有写权限。

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · 附属根 Skills：Settings → Plugins → Multi-root Workspace 中的 **启用附属根 Skills** 控制全部附属根，默认开启。关闭后阻止新的发现与调用，保留每根选择；恢复后按原值发现。主根 Skills、指令、LSP、文件浏览及沙箱权限不受此开关影响。旧版宿主使用兼容的插件设置页。命名空间引用按普通用户输入显示，不添加背景、高亮或点击预览；草稿内的原生 Skill 高亮暂不支持冒号引用。

升级时旧 `inherit` / `read-write` 登记会默认开启 Skills。持久化迁移保留原有 grant；旧版写回可能剥离 `aliasId` 和手动开关，再升级时重新按默认值迁移，**不保证 Skills 配置无损降级**。如需保留选择，降级前备份 `$DSH_HOME/storages/multi_root_workspace.json`。已投递正文仍留在历史中，禁用不会结束已经启动的进程。

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · 附属根 Skills：架构与验收边界见 [ADR-0023](./docs/decisions/ADR-0023-multi-root-skill-discovery-and-invocation.md)，实施和平台状态见[路线账本](./docs/plans/active/2026-09-12-multi-root-workspace.md#multi-root-skills-架构验证2026-10-23)。
@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · 面板：侧栏底部的 **Folders** 对话框列出主根与附加根，支持添加、移除、别名、切换只读/可写、复制路径与在文件管理器中显示。
@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · 模型侧：附加根的拓扑信息会注入系统提示词，让模型知道当前有哪些目录可用，授权变化时信息随之更新，不需要向模型提供新的工具。

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · 可选 Auto Review 适配：需要 Auto Review 多根上下文时，在插件管理器的主包行列表中启用默认关闭的 [Auto Review 入口](./src/auto-review/README.md)；同一详情页设置卡中的「多根 Auto Review（实验性）」开关与该行开关等价，默认同样关闭。该集成仅面向 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`；普通安装保持原支持范围且不会启用或选择 Auto。

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · 贡献指南：欢迎 Issue 与 PR：

1. 先读 [`AGENTS.md`](./AGENTS.md)（仓库级规则）与[开发工作流](./docs/development/plugin-development-workflow.md)（环境、命令、运行时支持矩阵、升级流程）。
2. 从 `main` 拉分支；提交信息遵循 conventional commits（`feat` / `fix` / `perf` / `refactor` + scope），参见现有历史。
3. PR 前本地必须全部通过：`pnpm lint`、`pnpm typecheck`、`pnpm build`、`pnpm test`、`pnpm docs:check`、`pnpm smoke`（CI 按同序执行，先 build 后 test）。
4. 影响行为的变更需同批更新 `docs/` 下的对应文档；README 保持中英双语同步；有取舍的工程决策请新增 ADR。
5. 硬约束：**不修改上游仓库（deepseek-harness）任何包**；插件只做 out-of-tree 扩展。

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · 已知限制：- **dsh-ops 只读限制绕过（F01，历史基线）**：审计版本在 Full-access 下，OPS Native `ops_write_file` 实际写入了显式只读附属根，而原生 fs 同次对照被拒。启用 OPS 兼容模式时，本轮有限适配已在 Full-access 下复验 explicit RO/cap deny 对 OPS Native 与真实 PTC 生效（deny 执行复验见[审计§16](./docs/reviews/dsh-ops-compatibility-audit.md#16-适配后复验)），版本、测试范围与原始证据见[兼容性审计](./docs/reviews/dsh-ops-compatibility-audit.md)。
- **dsh-ops 的合法写入与子目录指令缺口（F04/F05，历史基线）**：WW 下 inherit/固定读写附属根及 RO 下固定读写附属根被 OPS 预检拒写的问题未解决；OPS 读取不触发子目录指令发现（F05）已在启用模式的本轮 live 索引 + 真实 AgentLoop 下复验恢复（Native 与 PTC 成功触碰的子目录指令进入下一模型请求，见[审计§16](./docs/reviews/dsh-ops-compatibility-audit.md#16-适配后复验)）；不影响已验证的根级指令和 Skills 路径。
- **Linux bwrap 的 WW batch/result 降级（F07）**：审计版本的共享 Registry 下，所有到达启动分支且取得有效 cache 的 `ops_batch` / `ops_result`（含 `page`）都会因 confine 后追加 bind 而失去 argv 归属证明，源码路径将拒绝 Worker 启动并报 `EXECUTOR_UNAVAILABLE`。函数级冲突已复现，Linux 端到端未测；普通 RO、Landlock 和无 cache 对照不在此结论内。需 OPS 提供 confine 前的 cache 声明接口，目前没有已验证的 MR 单侧缓解，见[审计 F07](./docs/reviews/dsh-ops-compatibility-audit.md#131-n1--f07confine-后的-cache-bind-与严格证明冲突)。
- **其他 OPS 可用性边界**：共享 WW 下，调度外 purge 无有效 admission 时会被拒，结果缓存可能残留并告警；PTC 嵌套调用及后台 Bash 也有证明归属/过期导致的拒绝风险。本轮已完成保守拒绝边界的三平台验证；正常后台与清理能力仍未恢复

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · dsh-ops 适配现状（受限能力说明）：当前实现作为 **OPS 兼容模式（实验性，可能存在限制）** 开放：在 `Settings → Plugins → Multi-root Workspace` 中设置 `multi-root-ops-compatibility.enabled`，默认 `false`，必须显式开启。该功能仅允许在现有精确支持矩阵内的 DSH `0.2.*` 上启用；`0.1.*` 即使手工配置 `enabled: true` 也保持关闭，不提供旧版 Settings UI（[版本范围决定](./docs/decisions/ADR-0029-ops-file-authorization-and-activity-adapter.md#ops-版本范围修订2026-11-06)）。 从设置界面开启时，须阅读官方风险弹窗、勾选已了解限制并再次确认；确认前保持关闭，取消、关闭弹窗或按 Esc 均不保存开启设置。

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · What & Why：By default, [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) treats the directory a new workspace is created in as the agent's primary directory; under the default workspace read-write mode (`workspace-write`), the sandbox's read-write scope covers that directory alone. This plugin extends DSH's workspace scope to "one primary root + N additional roots".

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · What & Why：Not every project is a monorepo. A real development project is usually several independent Git repositories, and working across them meant juggling sessions. Peer harnesses already support adding multiple folders to a single workspace. This plugin brings the same capability to DSH — register the other repositories as additional roots, grant each read-only, read-write, or unrestricted access, and the agent can work in them within that grant.

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · What & Why：- **No new tools**: the agent keeps using the native `read` / `write` / `edit` / `bash`; only the granted directories grow.
- **Sandbox confinement**: an additional root may inherit the session's (primary root's) permission setting, or be pinned to read-only or read-write; under read-only and read-write, confinement does not rest on system prompts — it is enforced by an in-process filesystem fence plus kernel-level sandboxes (macOS Seatbelt / Linux bwrap / Landlock / Windows ACL), with native filesystem and bash calls passing through these fences sharing the same scope. Third-party tools that launch their own Workers need separate validation; see the current dsh-ops limitations below.
- **Browse additional roots in the Files tab**: the Files tab header switches between the primary root and any registered additional root; an additional root's directory renders in the same native Files view, with open-file, open-in-app, and auto-refresh behaving identically.
- **Optional Auto review (off by default)**: a fork of upstream's experimental auto-review that gives the reviewer the additional directories' context — the curren

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · What & Why：Current released version: `v0.1.15`. The user-visible changes of each version live in the [CHANGELOG](./CHANGELOG.en.md); progress and release state live in the [roadmap progress ledger](./docs/plans/active/2026-09-12-multi-root-workspace.md#进度总账).

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · Quick Start：The plugin is published on [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace). Open the **Plugins** page in the sidebar, choose **Add plugin**, and paste the package name `@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace` — or install it in two commands:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace
dsh --profile web       # pick the --profile for how you launch DSH; see its docs for the values
```

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · Quick Start：Once it is up, the **Folders** action (`🗂`) appears at the sidebar foot — or, straight in a session:

```text
/workspace-folders add ~/code/another-repo [--inherit|--read-only|--read-write]
```

The agent can now read, write, and run bash in that directory — the default is `inherit`, so the access level follows the session mode. Other install options (tarball, GitHub, a local clone) are covered under [Installation](#installation).

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · Requirements：**Using the plugin**: a DSH runtime at exactly one of the versions below — an exact match, not a range. `dsh plugin` handles the install; no local Node toolchain is needed.

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · Installation：The same install is available without the CLI: open **Plugins** in the sidebar, choose **Add plugin**, and enter the npm package name (or a Git address, tarball, or absolute local path).

`dsh plugin` supports four install sources. All commands below use the web profile as the example; for the Electron desktop swap `--profile web` for `--profile desktop` — the install method is the same.

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · Installation：| Source | Command | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| npm registry (recommended) | `dsh plugin --profile web add @dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace` | Pre-built artifacts, ready to use |
| GitHub | `dsh plugin --profile web add github:cherrchen/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace` | Builds automatically from source on install; `allowBuilds` must name this package too — pin a version |
| tarball | `dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-electron-dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace-<version>.tgz` | Pre-built offline package, handy for air-gapped or offline delivery |
| From source | `dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/package/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace` | pnpm `link:` to a local checkout — best for development; no `allowBuilds` needed |

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · Installation：**The first `dsh plugin add` fails with `[ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS]`**: add the following line to that profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, then run `add` again:

```yaml
allowBuilds:
  koffi: true
```

If the retry `exits 0` but the plugin never lands in `dsh.profile.bundles`, do a `remove` + `add`. Further diagnosis: [troubleshooting](./docs/troubleshooting/install-stops-at-build-approval.md).

dsh plugin --profile web add @dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace
```

This installs pre-built artifacts; the first install needs the `allowBuilds` addition described above.

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · Install from a tarball：```sh

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · Install from GitHub：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:cherrchen/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace
```

A GitHub install fetches source code and builds it automatically during `add` — no manual build needed — but `allowBuilds` has to cover two entries, this package itself and `koffi`:

allowBuilds:

  koffi: true
```

cd dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace
export CI=true

After startup, a **Folders** action appears at the sidebar foot.

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · Command：```text
/workspace-folders [list]                                                    # list the primary root and the additional roots (access and state included)
/workspace-folders add <absolute path> [--inherit|--read-only|--read-write]  # no path opens the OS directory picker; new registrations default to inherit
/add-dirs [absolute path] [--inherit|--read-only|--read-write]               # shortcut for /workspace-folders add
/workspace-folders access <n|path> inherit|read-only|read-write              # switch access (widening requires the root to be available right now)
@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · Command：Paths may be quoted; a path that duplicates an existing root, nests inside one, or is the workspace root itself is rejected.

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · Command：Access is three-state ([ADR-0017](./docs/decisions/ADR-0017-three-state-root-access-and-sandbox-modes.md); the [usage guide](./docs/guide/README.en.md#access-levels-the-root-limit-and-per-tool-caps) has the exact semantics): `inherit` follows the session mode — writable under `workspace-write`, refused under `read-only`, unrestricted under `danger-full-access`; `read-only` refuses writes in every mode, including Full-access; a fixed `read-write` root stays writable even in a read-only session. Writable records registered by older plugin versions read back as `inherit`. A primary root accepts at most 16 additional roots (`maxAdditionalRoots` can raise it to 64). A host may also cap a tool for all additional roots via `toolAccess` on the `multi-root-scope` row — e.g. `{ bash: 'read-only' }` keeps bash from ever writing an additional root (it can still write the primary root).

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · Command：After an `add`, `list` prints (a `workspace-write` session, with `website` registered read-only):

```text
Workspace root (primary; access follows the current sandbox mode): /home/me/monorepo
  1 /home/me/payments-service [payments] (inherit)
  2 /home/me/website (read-only)
2 of 16 additional roots.

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · Additional-root Skills：Skills are discovered in each additional folder’s `.dsh/skills` and `.agents/skills`. Names and descriptions are available before the first model step; bodies are loaded on invocation. The primary root uses `/skill-name`; additional roots always use `/alias-id:skill-name`, with Slash completion and manual entry. The model uses the native `skill` tool with an internal name. Internal IDs can appear in tool logs; human menus list namespaced references.

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · Additional-root Skills：New `inherit` and `read-write` registrations enable Skills by default; `read-only` registrations disable them. The Workspace Folders dialog provides an independent Skills toggle and editable `aliasId`. Renaming the display Alias keeps `aliasId` stable. An actual change to registered access resets the toggle; session sandbox mode changes, same-value access updates, and re-registration without an access change preserve the manual choice. Enabling Skills on a read-only root grants no write access.

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · Additional-root Skills：**Enable additional-root Skills** under Settings → Plugins → Multi-root Workspace controls all additional roots and defaults to on. Disabling it stops new discovery and invocation while preserving each root’s choice. Re-enabling restores discovery according to those choices. Primary-root Skills, instructions, LSP, browsing, and sandbox permissions retain their behavior. Older hosts use the compatible plugin settings page. Namespaced references appear as ordinary user text, without a separate background, highlighting, or click-to-preview action. Native draft highlighting does not yet support colon references.

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · Additional-root Skills：On upgrade, legacy `inherit` and `read-write` registrations start with Skills enabled. Migration preserves existing grants. An older plugin can strip `aliasId` and manual toggles when it writes the registry; upgrading again applies the defaults. **Lossless downgrade of Skills preferences is not guaranteed.** Back up `$DSH_HOME/storages/multi_root_workspace.json` before downgrading if preferences must survive. Disabling Skills does not remove previously delivered bodies from history or stop processes already started.

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · Additional-root Skills：See [ADR-0023](./docs/decisions/ADR-0023-multi-root-skill-discovery-and-invocation.md) for the architecture and acceptance boundaries, and the [progress ledger](./docs/plans/active/2026-09-12-multi-root-workspace.md#multi-root-skills-架构验证2026-10-23) for implementation and platform evidence.

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · Panel：The **Folders** dialog at the sidebar foot lists the primary root and the additional roots, and offers add, remove, alias, read-only/read-write switching, copy path, and reveal in the file manager.

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · Model side：The additional-root topology is injected into the system prompt so the model knows which directories are available, and the information updates when grants change. No new tool needs to be exposed to the model.

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · Optional Auto Review integration：For multi-root reviewer context, enable the default-disabled [Auto Review row](./src/auto-review/README.en.md) in the main package’s Plugin Manager row list; the experimental "Multi-root Auto Review" switch in the same detail page's settings card is equivalent to that row switch and is off by default as well. The joint integration targets only DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`; ordinary installation keeps the existing support matrix and does not enable or select Auto.

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · Project Structure：```text
.
├── src/
│   ├── roots.ts                      pure rules: canonicalization, conflict validation, record classification (available/missing/redirected/invalid)
│   ├── registry.ts                   one storage core and Host facades, store-wide ordering of mutations and admissions

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · Contributing：1. Read [`AGENTS.md`](./AGENTS.md) (repository-wide rules) and the [development workflow](./docs/development/plugin-development-workflow.md) (environment, commands, the runtime support matrix, the upgrade procedure) first.
2. Branch from `main`; follow conventional commits (`feat` / `fix` / `perf` / `refactor` + scope) — see the existing history.
3. All of these must pass locally before a PR: `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm build`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm docs:check`, `pnpm smoke` (CI runs the same order, build before test).
4. Behavior changes update the matching document under `docs/` in the same change; keep the README bilingual pair in sync; record engineering decisions that involve trade-offs as ADRs.
5. Hard constraint: **never modify any package of the upstream repository (deepseek-harness)**; the plugin stays an out-of-tree extension.

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · Known Limitations：- **dsh-ops bypassed an explicit read-only root restriction (F01, historical baseline)**: in the audited versions under Full access, the Native `ops_write_file` tool actually changed a file in an additional root pinned read-only, while the native filesystem control was denied. With OPS compatibility mode enabled, this round's limited adaptation makes the explicit RO/cap deny boundary effective for OPS Native and real PTC under Full access (deny-execution re-verification in [audit §16](./docs/reviews/dsh-ops-compatibility-audit.md#16-适配后复验)); see the [compatibility audit](./docs/reviews/dsh-ops-compatibility-audit.md) (Chinese) for versions, scope, and original evidence.
- **Legal additional-root writes and nested instructions had gaps with dsh-ops (F04/F05, historical baseline)**: OPS preflight still rejects inherited or pinned read-write additional roots under workspace-write and pinned read-write roots under read-only (F04 unresolved). The nested-instruction gap (F05) is re-verified as recovered with the mode enabled this round: with the live index, real AgentLoop evidence shows successful Native and PTC tou

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · dsh-ops adaptation status (capability notes)：The implementation is available through **OPS compatibility mode (experimental; limitations may apply)**. Set `multi-root-ops-compatibility.enabled` under `Settings → Plugins → Multi-root Workspace`; it defaults to `false` and requires an explicit opt-in. This feature can only be enabled on DSH `0.2.*` releases within the existing exact support matrix. On `0.1.*`, even a manually configured `enabled: true` stays inactive, and the legacy Settings UI is not supported ([version-scope decision](./docs/decisions/ADR-0029-ops-file-authorization-and-activity-adapter.md#ops-版本范围修订2026-11-06), Chinese). Enabling it from Settings opens the host’s risk dialog: acknowledge the limitations and confirm before the setting is saved. Cancel, close, or press Esc to keep it disabled.

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · dsh-ops adaptation status (capability notes)：- **Enabled**: activates OPS execution protection, live activity, and Review enhancements. Full-access (`danger-full-access`) enforces explicit RO/cap deny boundaries through kernel confinement on the verified macOS and Linux lanes. On Windows, deny-bearing OPS execution calls, including reads, are conservatively refused before Worker preparation; protected preparation and legal writes in that combination are not yet supported. In WW/RO, any non-writable additional root or tool write cap causes the entire OPS execution call, including reads/page, to be refused before preparation and execution. All modes refuse OPS execution when Registry authority is unavailable; pure discovery/publication remains available. Subprocess launches also require a protected execution domain or a profile from the current admission, preventing background cleanup from bypassing boundaries. This can also reject third-party background processes; the panel’s user terminal is unaffected.
- **Disabled**: restores OPS behavior from before this adaptation, without these safeguards — **OPS may write to an explicitly

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-multi-root-workspace README · dsh-ops adaptation status (capability notes)：The MR-only P5 safeguards require no OPS changes. Legal additional-root writes can still be rejected, and result caches may remain when cleanup is refused. In legacy mode without a shared Registry, WW/RO PTC can also be refused before its code process starts. Durable activity stays disabled: DSH explicitly prohibits external plugins from calling `appendPluginRecord`; ordinary events and direct log writes are not substitutes. P6 technical acceptance is complete for this bounded scope. Remaining P5 capabilities and full OPS compatibility acceptance are **deferred indefinitely** and excluded from this acceptance; any future recovery will remain experimental. The canonical deferred list is in [ADR-0029](./docs/decisions/ADR-0029-ops-file-authorization-and-activity-adapter.md#无限期延后清单唯一真源), with scope recorded in the [completed plan](./docs/plans/completed/2026-11-01-ops-compatibility-adaptation.md) (Chinese).
